# Nexora Technologies — Work-From-Home Policy

**Document ID:** HR-POL-011 (fictional, for training use only)

## 1. Eligibility

All full-time employees who have completed their probation period may work from home, provided their role does not require them to be on site every day.

## 2. How many days

Employees may work from home up to **2 days per week** with manager approval. Work-from-home days cannot be carried forward to the next week.

## 3. Expectations

While working from home, employees must be reachable on Teams between 10:00 AM and 4:00 PM, attend scheduled meetings with their camera available, and use the company VPN. Managers may cancel a work-from-home day when an in-person meeting is required, with at least one day's notice.

## 4. Equipment

Nexora provides a laptop and headset. Employees are responsible for a reliable internet connection at home; a monthly allowance of ₹1,000 is paid towards internet costs.
